name: COMP101_L4_Functions

relation_semantics.dependsOn: Pedagogical prerequisite: understanding/performing the subject requires the object to already be known. Direction: if A dependsOn B, B is learned first. In this module A-Box uses Skill→Skill and Concept→Concept only (OWL domain/range are owl:Thing). Concept→Concept dependsOn is intentional for teaching order / conceptual prerequisites (e.g. Argument dependsOn Function Call; Function Interface dependsOn Parameter). Do NOT reject Concept→dependsOn→Concept as a type error, and do NOT rewrite it to usesConcept.
relation_semantics.isRequiredBy: Inverse of dependsOn (OWL). A-Box is forward-only (dependsOn); do not expect asserted isRequiredBy triples.
relation_semantics.usesConcept: Subject relies on object Concept in a load-bearing teaching sense. OWL domain = union of Skill, Algorithm, LanguageConstruct, Operator, BuiltInFunction, Method; range = Concept. This module's A-Box uses Skill→Concept and Algorithm→Concept — BOTH are valid. Skills deliberately use usesConcept here (legacy; not requiresConcept). Algorithms use usesConcept to name concepts they illustrate. Do NOT flag Algorithm→usesConcept or Skill→usesConcept as subject-type errors. Do NOT rewrite usesConcept→Concept edges into usesConstruct (usesConstruct targets ConceptCarrier, not Concept).
relation_semantics.isUsedBy: Inverse of usesConcept (OWL). Domain Concept; range = same union as usesConcept domain. A-Box is forward-only.
relation_semantics.implementedBy: Concept is realized/expressed by a ConceptCarrier (LanguageConstruct, Operator, BuiltInFunction, or DataType). OWL: domain=Concept, range=ConceptCarrier. This module's A-Box is Concept→LanguageConstruct (def/return/pass). Domain is Concept only — never Algorithm (algorithms use usesConstruct for carriers).
relation_semantics.implementsConcept: Inverse of implementedBy (OWL). A-Box asserts only implementedBy.
relation_semantics.usesConstruct: Algorithm is coded with / employs a ConceptCarrier (LanguageConstruct, Operator, BuiltInFunction, or DataType). OWL: domain=Algorithm, range=ConceptCarrier. This module's A-Box is Algorithm→LanguageConstruct (def/return). Distinct from usesConcept (→Concept) and from implementedBy (Concept→carrier). Never propose usesConstruct with a Concept object (Parameter, Scope, Return Value, …).
relation_semantics.constructUsedBy: Inverse of usesConstruct (OWL). A-Box asserts only usesConstruct.
relation_semantics.acceptsType: BuiltInFunction accepts values of the object DataType as an argument/input. OWL: domain=BuiltInFunction, range=DataType. Means values OF that type (e.g. print() accepts str/int/bool values) — NOT 'accepts the type object itself'. Multiple acceptsType edges are a union of accepted input types and are fine. This module has no operatesOnType property.
relation_semantics.acceptedBy: Inverse of acceptsType (OWL). A-Box asserts only acceptsType.
relation_semantics.producesType: Subject yields/returns a value of the object DataType. OWL domain owl:Thing, range=DataType; this module's A-Box is BuiltInFunction→DataType.
relation_semantics.isProducedBy: Inverse of producesType (OWL). A-Box asserts only producesType.
relation_semantics.throwsError: Subject is associated with an ErrorType that can arise from incorrect use in this course. OWL: domain=owl:Thing, range=ErrorType; comment allows construct/function/method/concept. This module's A-Box is Concept→ErrorType (e.g. Function Call/Argument→TypeError, Scope/Local Variable→NameError) — Concept subjects are allowed. Range must remain ErrorType (never retarget throwsError to a Concept such as Function Call or Scope).
relation_semantics.isThrownBy: Inverse of throwsError (OWL). A-Box asserts only throwsError.
relation_semantics.methodOf: Method belongs to / is callable on the object DataType. OWL: domain=Method, range=DataType. Unused in this lecture's A-Box.
relation_semantics.hasMethods: Inverse of methodOf (OWL). Unused in A-Box.
relation_semantics.contrastsWith: Two entities that are alternatives, opposites, or commonly confused and should be distinguished. OWL domain/range owl:Thing; this module's A-Box is Concept↔Concept (e.g. Parameter↔Argument, Function Call↔Function Definition). Not a prerequisite (dependsOn) and not a usesConcept link.
relation_semantics.taughtIn: Entity is introduced or explicitly taught in the object Lecture. OWL: domain=Thing, range=Lecture. External-evidence gated for the judge.
relation_semantics.teaches: Inverse of taughtIn (OWL). A-Box asserts only taughtIn.

competency_questions.question: Which concepts does 'Manage Function Inputs and Outputs' (SK_FUNC02) use?
What does 'Reason About Function Execution' (SK_FUNC03) depend on?
Which concepts are taught in L04?

What are the prerequisite skills before 'Reason About Function Execution'?
Which errors can be thrown in the functions ontology?
Which builtins accept a data type (acceptsType)?

authoring_policy: Lecture 4 (Functions). Edge roles (match OWL + A-Box): (1) dependsOn = Skill→Skill or Concept→Concept prerequisites — allowed; do not convert Concept→dependsOn→Concept into usesConcept. (2) usesConcept subjects = Skill OR Algorithm → Concept; Algorithm→usesConcept is intentional. (3) usesConstruct = Algorithm → ConceptCarrier only (def/return/…). (4) implementedBy = Concept → ConceptCarrier only. (5) acceptsType = BuiltInFunction → DataType (values of that type). (6) throwsError range = ErrorType; Concept→ErrorType is allowed — never retarget the object to a Concept. Never 'fix' usesConcept→Concept by changing the predicate to usesConstruct.
